title: Legends identify series
summary: A legend matches a line or marker to its label. It is useful when one chart has more than one series.
introduction: A legend matches a line or marker to its label. It is useful when one chart has more than one series. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A legend matches a line or marker to its label. It is useful when one chart has more than one series.

blocks.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot([1, 2], [2, 3], label="Red team")
ax.plot([1, 2], [3, 4], label="Blue team")
ax.legend()
plt.show()
blocks.title: Legends identify series

blocks.text: The legend tells which line belongs to each team.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not rely on color alone to distinguish important series.
For more detail later, use this [Matplotlib further reading](https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/explain/quick_start.html).
